name: Token Dashboard
short_desc: Self-hosted dashboard for Hermes token-usage analytics with cost, latency, and model health
author: cori
description: Token Dashboard is a self-hosted analytics dashboard for Hermes LLM token usage. It reads the same `token_calls.db` that Hermes writes during agent turns, and renders per-provider cost, latency, peak-burn, error timelines, and a model-picker-watch panel that surfaces tracked-model health. Built with Python stdlib + PyYAML, served via a small threaded HTTP server with periodic regeneration. No external dependencies, no telemetry.

form_fields.label: Refresh Interval (seconds)
form_fields.hint: How often to regenerate the dashboard from the DB. 300 = 5 min.
